title: Staging export worker restart loop
summary: On 2026-02-18 the staging export worker restarted in a loop for 45 minutes after export_page_size was set to 0 during drill DR-44. Production did not serve this traffic.
impact: 12 fictional internal test accounts could not finish an export for 45 minutes.
The notes state that no production traffic used this worker during the window.
detection: Staging alert, export worker restarts greater than 5 in 10 minutes, fired at 16:42 America/Los_Angeles.

timeline.event: Page size flag export_page_size was set to 0 in staging for drill DR-44.
Staging alert, export worker restarts greater than 5 in 10 minutes, fired.
The on-call check confirmed the restarting worker was the staging worker.
Staging page size was set back to 100. Worker restarts stopped.
A test export for the 12 fictional internal test accounts succeeded.

contributing_factors.statement: The worker treated export_page_size 0 as retry immediately. The fictional notes show the flag at 0 from 16:40 until 17:20.
A production deploy caused the restarts. No production deploy is in the notes for this window, so this remains a hypothesis.

what_worked: The staging alert fired two minutes after the flag changed.
The worker served no production traffic.
what_was_slow: The drill checklist did not say that page size 0 is invalid, so the flag stayed at 0 until 17:20.

action_items.action: Reject export_page_size below 1 when the worker starts, and add a test for 0.
Add the invalid page-size case to the staging drill checklist.

drafting_notes: This draft is as of 2026-02-18. It is not the March release record. Leave the status at Draft until a review accepts it.
